about: Commonplace's suggested feeds, by category, in the order the Add Feed sheet lists them. Nothing here is subscribed until the person taps Add. To change the list, edit this file: `id` is a stable lower-case slug (it names the row's accessibility identifier), `url` is the feed itself (not the site), and `about` is one short line. Check every address still answers with a feed: run the ignored test `suggested_feeds_answer_with_feeds` (see the README).
